messages.author: 7b8fb897a1a0270e
messages.subject: PSCBS help !
parts:
I am trying to run segmentByPairedPSCBS on my illumina 1M dataset. This R function require CT parameter - which is a A numeric vector of J tumor total copy number (TCN) ratios in [0,+Inf). I am unable to get anything apart from BAF and LRR from Genomestudio output. How I can estimate CT from my data ?

Thanks
Reed

messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] PSCBS help !
parts:
LRR are basically log2 CN ratios centered around 0 whereas CT are
non-logged CN ratios centered around 2 (or whatever you think the
ploidy is), so CT = 2^LRR should do.

/H
